mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = '0' AND r.status = '0' AND m.status = '0' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_key FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = '0' AND r.status = '0'
